name: get_treasure_opened_flag

stack.evidence: func_001D6FD0 replaces the top value with func_0013C638(treasure_id), which reads the same persistent bit written by func_0013C5C8

notes: The result is the truthy bit mask 1 << (treasure_id & 3), or zero when unopened. Object initialization also queries this flag for type-8 treasure objects, while the reward routine indexes the 512-entry D_0034DA40 descriptor table with the same ID. All 167 JP calls use literal treasure IDs from 211 through 472.
